quote: changes the project reference graph, which requires approval
reason: ARC-020 requires approval for new layers/projects and ARC-001 fixes direction; no oracle policy makes individual reference edges between existing projects Reserved or forbids the CLI route for approved or layout references.
specific_behavior: 'dotnet add reference' fails even for an approved or layout reference, and a direction-legal edge outside the layout (e.g. Api -> Domain) needs a Decision Request.

quote: confirm its version, deprecation, vulnerability, and license steps were completed and report them
reason: DEP-003/DEP-004 require the checks; WF-009 covers verification reporting only; no oracle policy requires reporting dependency due-diligence results.
specific_behavior: A package addition summarized without its license and vulnerability results does not satisfy the hook feedback.

quote: Instruction-structure check failed after editing
reason: Instruction-system organization rule of the L0 template; the oracle defines no level hierarchy, header format or technology-neutrality requirement for instruction files.
specific_behavior: Naming EF Core in a Level 1 rule, or declaring a Level 0 file dependent on a Level 2 file, fails the checker and the edit must be fixed.

quote: deprecated resilience integration
reason: DEP-004 requires checking deprecation and DEP-020 treats direct Polly integration as an explicit exception; no oracle policy forbids specific packages outright regardless of approval.
specific_behavior: Adding Microsoft.Extensions.Http.Polly is reported as not allowed even when the user requests it.

quote: legacy automatic-validation integration
reason: DEP-010 fixes FluentValidation as the library and DEP-004 requires deprecation checks; no oracle policy restricts its ASP.NET integration package.
specific_behavior: Adding FluentValidation.AspNetCore for automatic validation is flagged and needs a recorded reason.

quote: Each rule has exactly one owner; other files point to it.
reason: Instruction-system placement and ownership rules; the oracle does not regulate where instruction content lives or how it is owned.
specific_behavior: Adding a must-rule only inside a knowledge skill, or restating a rule in a second owner, violates the template's placement rules.

quote: `"onFailure": "block"`
reason: Hook-configuration design of the template; no oracle policy regulates hook registration or failure semantics.
specific_behavior: Registering the hook through a shell command string, or making the post-edit hook blocking, fails the structure checker.

quote: Approved architecture changes are recorded here by `architecture-decision`
reason: GOV-017 requires approval for Reserved decisions but no recording format; GOV-007 covers product behavior sources. No oracle policy requires level-stratified decision summaries or makes package exceptions depend on them.
specific_behavior: After approval to use AutoMapper, the manifest check keeps flagging it until the accepted decision is written into decisions.md.

quote: registered with `FluentValidation.DependencyInjectionExtensions` from Application's own registration
reason: DEP-010 fixes FluentValidation and API-010 the validation boundaries; no oracle policy prescribes the registration package.
specific_behavior: Registering validators through hand-written scanning or another DI package deviates from the binding.

quote: commit `package.json` and `package-lock.json` and keep the lockfile consistent with every change
reason: Read as a version-control content convention the clause is entailed by DEP-007; read as an instruction to perform commits it conflicts with GOV-015 (commits only on explicit request). The text does not settle the reading.
specific_behavior: Under the commit reading an agent could commit lockfile changes without an explicit request.

quote: and its central version when no project uses it any more
reason: DEP-001..DEP-006 govern additions and central version placement; no oracle policy prescribes a removal procedure or the cleanup of unused central versions.
specific_behavior: Removing a PackageReference while leaving its PackageVersion entry in Directory.Packages.props does not complete the workflow.

quote: adopting versioning is Reserved
reason: API-013 allows introducing versioning when a real compatibility need exists and does not require approval; the oracle's consequential-change list does not name versioning adoption.
specific_behavior: With coexisting client generations the agent must still send a Decision Request before adding versioning.

quote: Delegated → proceed and mention it in the report.
reason: GOV-017 requires classification and reporting of unresolved Decision Requests in headless runs; no oracle policy requires reporting Delegated decisions or rejected requests.
specific_behavior: A completion report that omits the Delegated choices made does not follow the workflow.

quote: Backend build: PASS / NOT RUN / NOT APPLICABLE
reason: WF-009 requires reporting actual verification states only; no oracle policy prescribes failure/root-cause/changes sections.
specific_behavior: A repair summary without root cause or changes made does not satisfy the workflow.

quote: severity · file/location · problem · why it matters · smallest reasonable fix
reason: WF-011/WF-012 set priorities and forbid manufactured findings; the oracle prescribes no output format or severity scale.
specific_behavior: A review without severity levels or proposed fixes does not follow the procedure.

quote: Caching EF tracked entities across Unit of Work boundaries
reason: RUN-021 governs invalidation consistency and ARC-019 confines EF Core to Infrastructure; caching tracked entities is an EF technique pitfall (EXC-011 class) that the template turns into a named prohibition.
specific_behavior: An adapter that keeps tracked entity instances in a cache for later use cases violates the instruction even with correct invalidation.

quote: Treat migrations as source code: review each generated migration before committing it
reason: The oracle requires a migration only for schema-affecting CUSTOM_SETTINGS changes (PST-009) and review of generated migrations (PST-010); it has no general rule that every schema change is made through a new migration with fixed projects.
specific_behavior: A schema change applied through a hand-written SQL script or by editing an existing migration deviates from the workflow.

quote: Summarize what changed, the `verify` result block, unresolved Decision Requests, and remaining known issues.
reason: WF-009 covers the verification state and GOV-017 the listing of unresolved Decision Requests in headless runs; a fixed summary of changes and remaining known issues for every implementation is an additional reporting duty.
specific_behavior: A final message that reports only the verify block without the change summary and known issues does not follow the workflow.

quote: clearly required by an approved workflow
reason: GOV-015 permits repository-changing Git operations only on explicit request; 'clearly required by an approved workflow' names no workflow and may authorize high-risk operations without an explicit request, or may only refer to an explicitly approved procedure.
specific_behavior: Under the broad reading an agent could force-push or delete a branch because a workflow requires it, without an explicit request.

quote: treat `main`, `master`, and other protected/shared branches as non-rewritable
reason: GOV-015 allows repository-changing operations, including history rewriting, on explicit request; this rule forbids rewriting these branches without an approval path.
specific_behavior: Even when the user explicitly asks to force-push a rewritten main, the instruction tells the agent not to rewrite it.

quote: Never claim checks that were not run.
reason: No oracle policy prescribes PR description contents; WF-009 only requires truthful verification reporting.
specific_behavior: A PR description without the verification and migration notes does not follow the workflow.

quote: fire-and-forget EF async calls
reason: RUN-002 concerns blocking on async I/O and ARC-017 the shared scoped context; no oracle policy names unawaited (fire-and-forget) EF calls, which is EF technique turned into a prohibition.
specific_behavior: Starting an EF Core SaveChangesAsync or query without awaiting it violates the instruction.

quote: Do not wrap normal EF Core operations in a generic application-level retry pipeline.
reason: RUN-016 governs when retries are safe and the oracle treats database-retry examples as conditional technique (EXC-007); no oracle policy forbids an application-level retry pipeline around EF Core operations.
specific_behavior: Wrapping repository calls in a generic resilience retry pipeline violates the instruction even for idempotent reads.

quote: never mutate shared `DefaultRequestHeaders` concurrently
reason: RUN-005 governs client lifetime only; thread-safe header handling is client technique not stated by any oracle policy.
specific_behavior: Setting a per-user token on DefaultRequestHeaders of a shared typed client per call violates the instruction.

quote: `global.json` — pins the intended SDK line
reason: DEP-008 fixes the platform and DEP-023 repository-level build configuration; no oracle policy requires a global.json SDK pin or a particular roll-forward policy.
specific_behavior: A scaffolded solution without global.json, or pinned with rollForward disabled, deviates from the procedure.

quote: State that limitation in every report.
reason: WF-020 requires evidence-based contextual severity and WF-009 truthful status reporting; the oracle prescribes no report structure, severity scale or mandatory limitation statement.
specific_behavior: A security review delivered without the limitation statement or the per-layer table does not follow the procedure.

quote: disable-model-invocation: true
reason: Invocation and loading-surface rules of the template; no oracle policy regulates how the instruction system is maintained.
specific_behavior: The agent may not start template-maintenance on its own initiative, and moving path rules into the always-loaded surface violates the procedure.

quote: 'Kind:' classification is not part of this instruction model
reason: Inventory and model invariants of the L0 template; no oracle policy requires particular instruction artifacts, imports or forbids other instruction models' constructs.
specific_behavior: Adding a capabilities/ directory, a standalone resilience skill or a Kind: header fails the checker.

quote: **default** — deviation needs a concrete reason and must be reported
reason: The oracle's DEFAULT strength allows deviation for a concrete reason but requires no report of each deviation; the reporting duty and the vocabulary itself are template constructs.
specific_behavior: Choosing explicit transactions or a non-URL versioning strategy for a concrete reason must still be reported to the user.

quote: Unclear case — any **yes** makes it Reserved
reason: GOV-017 requires classification but not this test; under it any unclear dependency addition or removal becomes Reserved, whereas the oracle allows dependencies with a concrete need (DEP-001) and delegates routine internal choices (GOV-005).
specific_behavior: An unclear-case addition of a small utility package must go through a Decision Request instead of add-dependency alone.

quote: report a contradiction instead of choosing a side
reason: GOV-018 asks to raise concerns about questionable requests, including conflicts; no oracle policy defines precedence between instruction levels or requires reporting internal instruction contradictions instead of resolving them.
specific_behavior: When a Level 2 rule contradicts a Level 1 rule the agent must report the contradiction rather than follow either one silently.

quote: <Nullable>enable</Nullable>
reason: DEP-023 places shared settings in Directory.Build.props and DEP-008 fixes the platform; no oracle policy requires nullable reference types, implicit usings or the latest analyzer level.
specific_behavior: Every project compiles with nullable analysis and the latest analyzers, which changes warnings and which using directives are redundant.

quote: do not mix them casually with tracked entities for the same rows
reason: Imperative inside EF Core bulk-operation technique. Rejected as EXTRA: consistency caveat of an optional technique (EXC-011 class); 'casually' leaves the outcome to judgment.
specific_behavior: none

quote: never for validation failures
reason: 429 reference entry (EXC-009); standard HTTP semantics, no project-specific restriction.
specific_behavior: none

quote: do not convert every dependency failure to 502
reason: 502 reference entry (EXC-009); clarifies standard gateway semantics only.
specific_behavior: none

quote: not a business "nothing changed"
reason: 304 reference entry (EXC-009); standard conditional-request semantics.
specific_behavior: none

quote: never a browser launch URL pointing to HTTPS on an HTTP-only port
reason: Launch-profile technique (EXC-008); affects local developer launch configuration only.
specific_behavior: none

quote: Use several Swagger documents only for a real contract separation
reason: Document partitioning is OpenAPI tooling technique (EXC-008).
specific_behavior: none

quote: Do not test framework internals or duplicate the same behavior at every level.
reason: Frontend test targeting (EXC-018); consistent with behavior-focused testing, no separate restriction.
specific_behavior: none

quote: Do not duplicate identical tests per version.
reason: Versioning test targeting (test technique, EXC-012 class).
specific_behavior: none

quote: Verify observable behavior, not just the presence of `[Authorize]`.
reason: Authorization test targeting (EXC-012 class); rejected as EXTRA because no completion gate depends on it.
specific_behavior: none

quote: Numbers in examples are illustrative, not approved defaults
reason: Clarifies example values; retry counts and timeouts are internal technical values, not product tunables.
specific_behavior: none

quote: only when compatibility and deployment requirements justify them
reason: Conditional image-size technique (EXC-006).
specific_behavior: none

quote: never deserialize untrusted payloads into arbitrary runtime types
reason: Investigation prompt (EXC-015) stated imperatively; aligned with treating external data as untrusted (SEC-003); not registered as an independent runtime rule.
specific_behavior: none

quote: do not impose an arbitrary universal `ClockSkew`
reason: Investigation heuristic (EXC-015) limiting false positives; consistent with contextual severity (RULE-L0-0208).
specific_behavior: none

quote: Remove a dependency that the current change makes unused when doing so is safe to verify
reason: The bullet is marked '(prefer)', which the CLAUDE.md vocabulary defines as guidance; the removal suggestion is therefore not registered as EXTRA (the scope part is linked to RULE-L0-0024).
specific_behavior: none

quote: use it consistently with typed errors rather than strings
reason: Shape guidance for an optional Result pattern whose project-wide adoption is Reserved (RULE-L0-0007); technique of an approval-gated pattern.
specific_behavior: none

quote: never review isolated lines
reason: Review scoping technique (EXC-016 class); supports correctness-focused review.
specific_behavior: none

quote: if (readJson(stateFile)?.fingerprint === fingerprint) return;
reason: Executable default of the Stop hook: reminders are repeated only when the changed files or their relevant content change (fingerprint stored in the Git directory); outside a Git work tree the hook only reports that reminders are unavailable. Recorded in the exceptions of R8-R11.
specific_behavior: An unchanged state is not re-reminded.

quote: const index = content.search(/^## Accepted /m);
reason: Branch review: a review-listed package passes once its lowercase id appears anywhere in an '## Accepted' section of decisions.md or overview.md; the check does not verify that the text is an actual accepted decision. Recorded as the exception mechanism of R12-R15 and EXTRA-L0-0005.
specific_behavior: Any mention of the package id in an Accepted section silences the finding.

quote: if (failed || !found.some(item => item.kind)) return;
reason: Enforcement limitation: outside a Git work tree post-bash scans manifests only after a recognized dependency command, so manifest changes made by other commands are not validated. Not an additional rule.
specific_behavior: none
